answer: Juries do not structurally preserve minority reasoning: FRCP 31 requires a unanimous verdict, and a poll that reveals dissent restarts deliberation or ends in mistrial, so the verdict form has no minority-report field (M7, norm-dependent as a preservation mechanism). Standards bodies split. W3C Formal Objections are structurally-enforced: the objection MUST state issue, decision and rationale, a record MUST be made publicly available, and a Call for Review MUST identify related FOs (M1; field formal_objections). IEEE-SA recirculation is structurally-enforced: the ballot package MUST carry verbatim unresolved Do Not Approve comments, voter name, and the CRG response (M2; field unresolved_negative_comments). IETF rough consensus (RFC 7282) tells chairs to explain unaccommodated objections but the RFC artifact has no required dissent section (M6, norm-dependent; not a gate). Regulatory panels split the same way. FOMC minutes structurally name members 'Voting against this action' plus a one-line preference (M3; field vote.against). FDA 21 CFR 14.60 requires minutes of matters discussed, but closed deliberative minutes may not refer to members by name, so attributed dissent is not a checkable field (M5, norm-dependent). ICJ Statute Article 57 entitles any judge to a separate opinion published with a non-unanimous judgment (M4; field dissenting_opinions). The council-transferable hard gate is minority_reports (required keys author_id, rationale, claim_ids, sha256), fed by M1-M4 only. A synthesizer instruction to include dissent, including the named failure class at _USER-PROMPTS.md:11340, is not a gate (M8). SUCCESS:RES-0086 in the receipt AND a mechanism table with an enforcement classification and a named checkable artifact field

strongest_surviving_counterargument: FOMC and IEEE preserve identity-plus-comment into a process package, not a full minority essay in the final published standard or policy statement. Mapping them onto minority_reports therefore over-fits if the gate demands a long rationale the source institution never required.
